reviews.t: Much Smaller than the Real Thing
reviews.x: These are much smaller than the ones I used to wear in the 90's. I'm an actress and purchased these for a 90's sketch and they're tiny. The spring itself is strong, so if you're buying for a baby or little girl, they'll work fine. I'm a grown woman however and had to secure my hair with bobby pins first, then clip these on top. Looks silly with how small they are. [See Cassie's review for a side-by-side comparison. I wish I'd seen that before ordering.] Also feels over priced for this size.

reviews.t: Cute but;
reviews.x: These are so cute but; 1) they are tiny 2) you are paying for 100, I only recieved 95 3) one came broken :( I recieved 10 blue, 10 red, 10 orange, 18 green, 8 yellow, 11 & 1/2 light pink, 14 purple, 14 dark pink

reviews.t: Great product missing a few otherwise nice for thin haired children and those with thin hair
reviews.x: Missing a few pieces and broken butterflies so going to return otherwise very happy with these. I think it is great for those with fine hair as an adult with fine hair this worked fine. So I imagine young children would be easy. I got these for a 1990s party and to hold back so layered pieces during the day/workout. These are not like the 1990s ones I had as a child so definitely will be on the lookout for the originals which were larger in size. However, these hold fine you just cant tell they'

reviews.t: These are cute clips but they are not quite like the ones from the 90s
reviews.x: These are cute clips but they are not quite like the ones from the 90s.  They are actually much smaller and a cheaper plastic.  I received a mixture of colors for a total of 98 clips and 2 of the 98 were damaged.  My color assortment was: 21 green 15 blue 15 orange 13 purple 9 dark pink/red 9 light pink 9 yellow 7 purple pink color  We use these for our small dogs and they work fine for that.  For our shih tzu they hold well because her hair is really fine but for our shih poo mix that has thick

reviews.t: Fine for toy dolls
reviews.x: For some reason I thought they were bigger, I went under the guess of "small" but these are more like miniatures, something used in a toy dollhouse or little dolls.  I had planned on using these to hold up the small stems of the small orchids growing up the wooden pole, they were even too small for that purpose.

reviews.t: While these LOOK like those 90s hair clips from when I was younger
reviews.x: While these LOOK like those 90s hair clips from when I was younger, these are half the size. It will be good for baby dolls or young toddler girls with really thin hair. I have one that has thick hair and one with thin hair. The girl with the thicker hair, is probably going to cry when she sees her sister wearing them and she can't.

reviews.t: Really Small
reviews.x: I bought these thinking they would be like the small plastic butterfly clips we all wore in the 80's & 90's.  These are teeny tiny clips and not the same size as the ones popularized during the 80's & 90's.  I would say these are made for babies or toddler more so that teens or adults.

reviews.t: Sad.
reviews.x: I was looking forward to reliving the 90s with these clips but they are SO SMALL!  They are less than a centimeter wide, about half the standard size I expected them to be. They can barely hold any hair!  Sad.

reviews.t: Too tiny
reviews.x: Too tiny and too expensive. I did not expect such a small  package of clips.

reviews.t: Very Cute and Stylish Hair Clips!
reviews.x: These hair clips are very cute! The design is nice and they look nice and stylish. I got 100 butterfly shaped hair clips in assorted glittery colors. Each hair clip size is about 5/8" L. They are made of good quality plastic that will not break easily. I had them for almost a month now and, so far none of them were broken, they seems to last long. I like them, except that they are not really the right size for my hair. I had thick long straight hair and they are difficult to use because the

reviews.t: Great for toddlers, tiny clips for fine hair.
reviews.x: These teeny little clips are great for toddlers because they hold small amounts of fine hair without sliding out...they are comfortable to wear and they look really cute. Lots of bright colors to match any outfit. Also they're nice and light, so if you want to put a whole row of them in, they won't feel heavy and they won't drag at the child's hair. The only caveat is that occasionally you'll get one with a manufacturing flaw, a wing that looks melted or "teeth" that don't quite line up.

reviews.t: holds my toddlers hair and shiny butterflies
reviews.x: I have been looking around for this hair clips for my toddler who have fine hair. she always need to make her hair pretty at least before going to pre-school. this hair clips holds my toddlers tiny fine hair with a plus of they are butterfly. who wouldn't like butterflies? all little girls love them. they are colorful and shiny. my toddler don't know which color she pick everyday.  I received 100 Pack of 90's Butterfly Hair Clips, 90's by Cornucopia Brands for free for my unbiased and honest own

reviews.t: but kept a stash for myself which are very useful when clipping up sections to curl my hair
reviews.x: Purchased these for a 90's nostalgia birthday party, and they were quite a hit.  I had one or 2 break as I was putting them in, but once they were properly clipped, there were no problems, and they stayed in the rest of then night.  I gave most of them away, but kept a stash for myself which are very useful when clipping up sections to curl my hair.

reviews.t: Choking hazard, broken, and sharp edges!!!!!
reviews.x: Smaller than expected,  my toddler could swallow them they're so little. Also, they are made so cheap. Some of them don't look like butterflies...some of them don't have the metal pin and spring in them, and some are chipped with very sharp edges. I will buy something else for my toddler as these are way too dangerous. Very poor quality. Not happy.

reviews.t: but they break easily and so small I lose them easily
reviews.x: Very tiny- about .25" wide. I was hoping for the 1" size that I had when I was a kid. I can't seem to find that size anywhere. I wish these vendors would place these NEXT to an object to get an idea about what the size you're getting really will be. I do use them, but they break easily and so small I lose them easily.

reviews.t: Lots of broken Pieces
reviews.x: I was looking forward to these clips. I wore them when I was little an have an even coming up 90s theme I really wanted to wear them. First of all I didn't get 100 pieces I got 92 and a few halfs and some little pieces of plastic. Lots of the wings where chipped off. I'm quite disappointed in them I was so excited  !

reviews.t: Horrible
reviews.x: I read some of the reviews and decided I would give the product a chance despite it being smaller.  What a mistake!  These little butterflies are cheaply made, break easily, and the hinge is bigger than the butterfly so it looks like colorful hinges in the hair!  Ridiculous.

reviews.t: Meh
reviews.x: Not exactly the butterfly clips I remember from the 90's. They are a bit smaller. Not the same design. A few were broken when I opened the package. And my daughters complain that they hurt their head. All in all,  they still work. And if you want a knock off go for it.

reviews.t: Much smaller than I expected but I probably didn't read ...
reviews.x: Much smaller than I expected but I probably didn't read the description as well as I could have.  I remember butterfly clips being about the size of the tip of your thumb - these are much smaller - doesn't hold much hair.

reviews.t: I thought these were the regular sized butterfly clips that ...
reviews.x: I thought these were the regular sized butterfly clips that I used a kid. But these are MICRO MINIS. They were still able to work but it took FOREVER to do my hair. Also they are VERY CHEAPLY made. Not worth the price.

reviews.t: Chinese crap
reviews.x: Chinese crap! Can't even be squeezed easily so they can be put on the hair. Hardly take any hair, they are too small. Maybe if you wanted them for decoration but can't see how they can serve any purpose...

reviews.t: Great!!!
reviews.x: Absolutely what I was looking for!! My little sister has course curly natural hair and these look so cute on her and so easy for her 9 year old self to use! Will buy more when they all disappear :)

reviews.t: Came with only 68 clips.
reviews.x: It was supposed be 100 count but my package only included 68. Also, it was missing blue and light pink colored clips. I am so disappointed and do not recommend ordering this product to anyone!

reviews.t: Very small and they break easily. I wouldn't let a toddler who pulls things ...
reviews.x: Very small and they break easily. I wouldn't let a toddler who pulls things out the hair have these as they are definitely a choking hazard. They are pretty and come in a variety of colors

reviews.t: I like the Butterfly Hair Clips but I wish they were ...
reviews.x: I like the Butterfly Hair Clips but I wish they were more defined (one could really tell the clips were butterflies).  Perhaps if the wings were opened more; however they will work.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the clips much smaller than expected, often describing them as tiny or miniature compared to the 90s originals.
Several reviewers report receiving fewer clips than the advertised 100, with some arriving broken or damaged.
Reviewers say the clips work well for toddlers and children with fine or thin hair.
Some reviewers find the clips cute and stylish, with nice colors and good quality plastic.
A few reviewers mention the clips break easily or have sharp edges.
